lead: The assistant's reasoning: a collapsible region whose trigger is one sentence ("Thought for 4s") and which expands into a vertical timeline of steps. While streaming, the trigger text shimmers, and each step can be marked done / in progress / not started.

usage.title: Usage
usage.planText: Add a sidebar slot to the layout.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: With `streaming` the trigger shimmers; the steps come in one by one and the last one is `active`.

api.title: API Reference
api.root: The root takes the open state of Base UI's Collapsible: `defaultOpen` uncontrolled, or `open` + `onOpenChange` controlled.
api.trigger: The trigger (`button`): one sentence plus an expand arrow; the text shimmers only when it is a string.
api.steps: The vertical timeline of steps (`ol`), with no props of its own.
api.step: One step (`li`): `label` is its title; `status` sets the dot: `done` filled, `active` pulsing (with `aria-current="step"`), `pending` hollow.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.panel: The expanded panel (its height animation reads `--collapsible-panel-height`) and the content inside it
